claims.claim: bacterial abundance follows log₁₀ cells/mL = 5.867 + 0.776·log₁₀ chl (Bird & Kalff 1984; abstract only)
claims.source_value: the abstract: log AODC = 5.867 + 0.776 log chl a, r² = 0.88; AODC = bacteria per mL (acridine orange direct counts), chl a in µg/L; fresh and marine waters pooled (their regressions were statistically indistinguishable)
claims.note: full text not read: the digits match the abstract, but the log base (presumably 10), the data's range of chlorophyll, n, and whether the chlorophyll is epilimnetic or seasonal means need the paper

claims.claim: which at 33.1 fg C per cell (Tulonen 1993) and 3–5 µg/L chlorophyll gives about 57–85 µg C/L (project estimate)
claims.note: the arithmetic is right on the abstract's equation taken as base 10: chl 3 → 10^(5.867 + 0.776 × 0.477) = 1.73 × 10⁶ cells/mL × 33.1 fg = 57 µg C/L; chl 5 → 2.57 × 10⁶ cells/mL → 85 µg C/L. The input stays unconfirmed until the full text is read (and the 33.1 fg C/cell is Tulonen's, checked under that key)
